subject: general
question: The downstream speed is 41 km/hr and the upstream speed is 20.5 km/hr. It takes a boat a total of 13 hours to go to a place and come back. What is the total distance travelled by the boat?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Total distance** = 2 × [(**Downstream Speed** × **Upstream Speed**) ÷ (**Downstream Speed** + **Upstream Speed**)] × **Total Time**

**Total distance** = 2 × [(41 × 20.5) ÷ (41 + 20.5)] × 13

**Total distance** = 2 × [(41 × 20.5) ÷ 61.5] × 13 = 2 × (41 ÷ 3) × 13

**Total distance** = 1066/3 km

**∴ The correct answer is 1066/3 km.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e4eb19a5b3c060438bb16a94b4d2eece7cf7a68f096a0cbb5b7fccd203534008.png] 

**Given:**

**Downstream Speed** (u) = 41 km/hr

**Upstream Speed** (v) = 20.5 km/hr

**Total Time** (T) = 13 hours

**Formula Used:**

Time = Distance ÷ Speed

Total Distance = 2 × One-way Distance (D)

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total Time = (D ÷ u) + (D ÷ v)

⇒ 13 = (D ÷ 41) + (D ÷ 20.5)

⇒ 13 = (D + 2D) ÷ 41

⇒ 13 = 3D ÷ 41

⇒ 3D = 13 × 41 = 533

⇒ D = 533/3 km

⇒ Total distance travelled = 2 × D = 2 × (533/3)

⇒ Total distance = 1066/3 km

**∴ The correct answer is 1066/3 km.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Speed of Boat and Stream

Speed of boat in still water (x) = (Downstream + Upstream) ÷ 2. Speed of stream (y) = (Downstream − Upstream) ÷ 2.

Average Speed for Round Trip

Average Speed = (2 × u × v) ÷ (u + v). Total Distance = Average Speed × Total Time.

Relative Speed in Water

Downstream speed = Speed of boat + Speed of current. Upstream speed = Speed of boat − Speed of current.</p
